_note: Which model does which job. Change a name here and no code changes. Prices are USD per million tokens; fill them in from Google's current price page and the run log will show an estimated cost (left null, it shows token counts only).

limits._note: 30 Oct 2026 (owner): a long bill's frontier sections (up to 160,000 characters, agents/sections.mjs) are read in one request, so one call may hold 200,000 characters and one item 250,000 tokens; the monthly cap still bounds the month.

scope_check_limits._note: Own limits for scope-check/run.mjs (the one-off LegiScan catch-up reads hundreds of bills).

_note_provider: provider "gemini" for building and testing; switch to "anthropic" for production (roles below, key ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). No temperature on Claude: current models reject non-default sampling; effort sets thinking depth.

generator._note: Owner, 30 Oct 2026: Sonnet writes new entries (Haiku's drafts lost qualifiers and quotes in the paid re-tests). The validator stays Haiku (an independent reader; code checks every quote and number).

referee._note: Second opinion on scope, asked only when the generator and the validator rule a bill out or disagree, and on every new entry before it is published. Its answer is final (no person reviews held items). Opus since 30 Oct 2026: it must be a different, stronger model than the generator (now Sonnet).

reviewer._note: Self-correction (correct/): re-reads a bill against its current entry and lists errors and omissions, each with a quote.

confirmer._note: Self-correction: must confirm each proposed correction before code applies it.

escalation._note: agents/run.mjs: an item held because it used up max_tokens_per_item or ran out of rounds (a long bill) is tried ONCE more in the same run, written by the generator_role model (the validator stays the independent reader), reading a long bill section by section, within max_tokens_per_item below (spent under the item's own sub-keys, so the run limit and the monthly cap still apply). Still held after that: escalate: true in results, read again only when its record changes.

_note_cost: Prices are USD per million tokens (Claude, 26 Oct 2026). Haiku 5.5 is $0.10 in / $0.50 out up to 100K prompt tokens and $0.50 / $2.50 above that (the whole call). monthly_cost_cap_usd stops all AI work for the rest of the month; a warning goes out at monthly_warn_fraction of it.
